cd /workspace/submission && python3 - << 'EOF'
# final review: verify JSON output shape of every op against the published schemas
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import engine

prof = {"groups":2,"jitter_ps":[1,2],"measurements":[[0,1,2,4]]}
fab = {"n":2,"interval_ns":1,"slice_ns":8,"offset_ns":0,"drift_ppb":[1,1],
       "heat":[[1,0,4,2]],"anchors":[[0,0,8]],
       "links":[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,1]],"delay_ns":[2,3],"defer_rounds":[1,0]}],
       "slices":[[0]],"blackouts":[[0,2,3]],"guards_ns":[0,1],"reconfig_ns":1}
trace = {"rounds":4,"rates_ppb":[[1,1],[1,2],[1,1],[1,2]],"bias_ps":[3,-1],
         "sends":[[5,0,0,100],[6,0,0,-100],[7,2,1,0]],"lost":[6],
         "reboots":[[2,1]],"queries":[0,2,4]}

def keys(o, want):
    assert set(o.keys()) == set(want), (set(o.keys()), set(want))

c = engine.op_calibrate(prof); keys(c, ["status","upper_ps","pred"])
p = engine.op_plan(prof, fab)
keys(p, ["status","profile","period_rounds","peaks_as","guard_ns","bounds_as",
         "age_rounds","pred","warmup_cycle"])
keys(p["profile"], ["status","upper_ps","pred"])
a = engine.op_audit(prof, fab, p); keys(a, ["valid"]); assert type(a["valid"]) is bool
r = engine.op_replay(prof, fab, 0, trace)
keys(r, ["status","states","send_status","delivered","adopted","unknown_payloads",
         "stale_payloads","pending","peak_known_abs_as","always_known"])
for st in r["states"]:
    keys(st, ["bounds_as","errors_as","adopted","generations"])
    for v in st["generations"]: assert type(v) is int
    for v in st["adopted"]: assert v is None or type(v) is int
    for v in st["bounds_as"]+st["errors_as"]: assert v is None or type(v) is int
assert type(r["always_known"]) is bool
for v in [r["delivered"],r["adopted"],r["unknown_payloads"],r["stale_payloads"],
          r["pending"],r["peak_known_abs_as"]]: assert type(v) is int
print("schema shapes OK")
print(json.dumps(r, separators=(',',':'))[:400])
EOF
